discernVibes: Have I met or heard of them before?
What do I think they aren't telling me?
How do they really feel about me/us?
What do they want most right now?
Who here has leverage over them?
How can I get them to trust me?
catchTheScent: Who or what was here recently?
Have I encountered something like this before?
If we're familiar, what do I recall about it/them?
Where did they go from here?

soft: Reveal signs of approaching danger
Show evidence of recent activity (blood trail, broken window, fresh grave)
Have an NPC act suspicious or nervous
Foreshadow a threat without showing it directly
Present a difficult choice with no good options
Put a countdown or deadline on something important
Show a glimpse of something terrible about to happen
Make an ominous portent (bad omen, unsettling dream, cryptic warning)
Reveal that time is running out (dawn approaches, meeting in one hour, etc.)
hard: The deadline arrives; consequences happen now
The foreshadowed threat materializes in full force
The difficult choice becomes unavoidable; choose right now or lose both options
The danger you've been building toward strikes

soft: Someone or something appears unexpectedly (but not immediately hostile)
A plan develops an unforeseen snag
Equipment starts failing or acting unreliable
An ally becomes distracted or difficult
The environment shifts (weather changes, crowd gathers, noise draws attention)
A secret threatens to be exposed
Introduce a new wrinkle to the situation
hard: Equipment fails catastrophically at the worst moment
An ally becomes a direct problem (betrays, panics, gets captured)
The environment becomes immediately dangerous (fire, collapse, flood)
A secret is exposed to the worst possible person
Someone arrives who absolutely shouldn't be there
Turn one problem into two distinct crises happening simultaneously

soft: Put them in a dangerous or compromising position
Threaten someone or something they care about
Show them they're being watched or followed
Give them a warning shot (miss on purpose, demonstrate power)
Present escalating danger they can still escape
hard: Inflict Harm as established
Capture or restrain a character
Separate one character from the group
Take away their stuff (weapons, phone, car keys, blood bags)
Force them to make a desperate Move right now
Give them a choice: sacrifice something or face consequences immediately
Injure or kill an NPC they care about
Activate a Compulsion at the worst moment (demand Stay Chill roll)

soft: Mortals witness something unusual (but not definitively supernatural)
Someone starts asking questions
Evidence could be left behind if they're not careful
An investigator gets interested
Someone's phone is out and recording
hard: Mortals definitively witness something supernatural
Security footage captures the act
A witness films or photographs clear evidence
Authorities arrive on scene right now (cops, FBI, health inspectors)
Social media posts go viral
Someone recognizes a character from "that incident"
Start or advance the Masquerade Clock
The Sheriff's people show up to investigate

soft: Show signs that an enemy is making progress
An enemy prepares something (gathering resources, scouting, setting up)
Opposition gains information about the Coterie
They plant seeds of doubt or discord
Show that they're one step ahead
hard: An enemy achieves a goal or milestone
A rival Coterie moves into the territory
Hunters discover a vital clue about the Coterie
An Elder vampire takes direct notice and acts
Opposition turns an NPC against the Coterie
They spring a prepared trap or ambush
They make a decisive Move while the Coterie is distracted
Start or advance an Opposition Clock

soft: Present temptation aligned with their Compulsion
Surround them with blood smell when Hunger is high
Mention a Touchstone is in potential danger
Hint that someone wants to call in a Debt soon
Present a situation where Humanity and survival might conflict
Show them what they want (but make the cost unclear)
hard: Trigger a Compulsion (demand **Stay Chill** roll immediately)
Increase someone's Hunger through circumstance
Threaten or harm a Touchstone right now
Call in a Debt at the worst possible moment
Force them to choose between Humanity and survival this instant
Use their Bane against them
Make their low Humanity a direct liability
Exploit a character's Conviction or personal code in a way that hurts
Remind them viscerally what they've lost (their mortality, their family, their dreams)

soft: Hint that the Haven has a problem (strange noises, complaints, inspector scheduled)
Show signs of territory encroachment
Have someone mention wanting payment soon
Indicate their reputation is slipping
Show wear and tear on important assets
hard: The Haven is directly threatened (fire, raid, eviction, structural damage)
Reduce Currency, Clout, or Claim
Mark or demand a Coterie Debt
Cut off a resource they rely on (blood supply, safe house, contact)
Someone demands payment or tribute right now
Their territory is actively encroached upon
A valuable asset is damaged, destroyed, or stolen
Their reputation takes a significant hit
Bills come due with immediate consequences
Start or advance a Haven Clock

soft: Offer an opportunity with a visible cost
Ask provocative questions and build on their answers
Reveal an unwelcome truth (but not devastating)
Show them a downside of their nature (hunger, immortality, isolation)
Make them face something uncomfortable from their past
hard: Turn their Move back on them with full force
Tell them the immediate consequences and ask what they do
Reveal a devastating truth
Show them the full cost of their previous choices
Put them in an inescapable moral quandary
Make a Hard Move from one of your prepared Threats
